description: Replaces the content of ONE existing question/item of a question bank entirely - not a merge: blockType, category, difficulty and columns must all be sent even when unchanged, and a column or value left out is gone from the draft. blockType is immutable: a different value is rejected rather than retyping the item (delete it with question_bank_item_delete and add a new one instead). Read the item with question_bank_get_items first and send it back with its value ids intact. The change lands in the bank's DRAFT - question_bank_publish makes it live, question_bank_discard_changes throws every unpublished change away again. "hasChanges" in the response says whether the bank now has unpublished changes. Rejected for a public template id. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

blockType.description: The item's current block type, sent back unchanged (question_bank_get_items returns it). Immutable: a different value is rejected.

category.description: The item's category - free text, used to filter what a QuestionBank block draws.

additionalProperties.description: The values of this column, in order - either plain strings/numbers, or the {"id": .., "value": ..} objects question_bank_get_items returns. Position in this array is what defines the order; the "id"s carry no order of their own.

id.description: The value's ID as returned by question_bank_get_items for this item; omit or null to have one assigned, and an ID the item does not have is rejected. It is an opaque handle for addressing THIS value on an update and nothing else - never sort or index by it (riddle://reference/concepts/question-bank-items). A column's order is the order of this array alone.

columns.description: The question content, as {columnName: [values]}. This replaces the content entirely rather than merging: send every column, and hand question_bank_get_items output straight back with its {"id", "value"} objects intact - keeping those ids is what edits the stored values instead of replacing them with a fresh set.

difficulty.description: The item's difficulty, 1-10 - also used to filter what a QuestionBank block draws.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank the item belongs to.

questionBankItemId.description: The ID of the item to update, as returned by question_bank_item_add/question_bank_get_items.

name: question_bank_item_update
